steps.title: Build a new page with blocks
items: 4 · Edit in Layout, Content and Split view

steps.caption: Click **New** › Page, name it and click **Create**
The editor opens in **Layout** view: the page as visitors see it

steps.name: Story
steps.caption: Start from a template: **Panels** › Templates › **Add** on Story
**Content** view shows the page as a document. Each block is a table
Click below the last block to add more

steps.name: Cards (features)
steps.caption: Open **Blocks**, search the Library and add **Cards (features)**
Click below it again for the next block

steps.name: Related articles (by keywords)
steps.caption: Complex blocks too: **Related articles** pulls stories from the site index
Back in **Layout** view, the new blocks are styled and live
Edit right on the page: double-click a word and type
Related articles are filled in from the site automatically
**Split view**: edit the document and watch the page update
